wayback._eras_pending: Written after the CDX enumeration of bvcapital.com (BV Capital 2000-2012), eventures.vc / eventures.com (e.ventures 2012-2021) and headline.com (2021-); the Internet Archive was under a machine-wide cooldown at kickoff (2026-09-27 15:19 to 16:19 local). The live 2026 list is read through site_api.

roster._note: Kickoff roster (sources/wayback/partner-roster.json) is curated from the firm's own Form D related persons (every e.ventures / Headline / BV Capital vehicle, dated by filing), the Form ADV Schedule A owners of the six Headline advisers, and the live CMS investing team (sources/site/team-cards.json); the CDX people sweep extends windows when the archive answers.

sources._note: Every company doc of the public Sanity dataset behind headline.com (project iznipsfw), read by scratch/build-site-layer.py: 211 on the rendered portfolio grid, 38 only in an investor's portfolio list on /team/<member>/, 44 hidden CMS docs (surface cms_hidden, judged on corroboration, never on the doc alone). 'desks' are the fund pages (US, EU, Global Growth, Asia, Brazil) that list the company; 'stages' the firm's own dated entries per fund ('Early 2019; Growth 2021'); 'partners' the investors whose team page lists it.

site_api._entry_stage_note: The per-company 'stages' list is the firm's own dated entry per fund ('Early', 'Growth', one 'Seed'). 'Early' straddles Seed and Series A and is an anchor like a bare year; 'Growth' names the Global Growth fund's entry and may label only after it is scored blind against documented rounds (decisions.md D10). Not in entry_stage_fields until scored.

edgar._note: Entity-qualified phrases only: 'Headline' is a common word and 'eVentures' a common company name (eVentures Group Inc, a 1999 Dallas internet holding company, is a namesake).

desks._note: One firm under successive names (BV Capital 2000, e.ventures 2012, Headline 2021): the US, Europe and Global Growth vehicles under the six Headline advisers (decisions.md D1), and since Erik's E1 (2026-09-28) the Asia desk (Infinity Ventures, Headline Asia from 2021) and the Brazil desk (Redpoint eventures 2012, Headline Brazil): both operate under the Headline name and affiliate with the firm, so nothing is partitioned. The desk labels stay on the rows for reporting.

verify._unicorn_bands_note: Rule A (Erik 2026-09-06): the unicorn snapshot is an aggregator, a coverage floor to verify, never a mark.

shape._note: The 0.80 default stands. There is no ceiling on the $1B+ share (Erik, 2026-09-26).
